matchups.tips: | FOR TOPLANE | Oh boy did the buffs make this matchup impossible. My personal ban right now.

| FOR MIDLANE | Ban this champion. | She out roams you, out lanes you, out damages you, out scales you. | If you win it's because she is terrible, not because you were good. This matchup is not playable.

| FOR MIDLANE | Ban this champion | Same as Qiyana. Totally unplayable matchup for Zilean. He out roams you, out lanes you and his damage is very fast and unpredictable meaning you cannot properly R against him. | Extremely difficult to lane against.
| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Ban this champion. | Same issues as Zed and Qiyana. Unplayable lane. She out roams you, out trades you and is impossible to lane against.

| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Completely unplayable in toplane. Just dodge this is not winnable unless you are playing out of your mind. | In midlane it is playable, but extremely hard! Try to play with your jungler that is your only way to win it.

| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Impossible in toplane. Extremely hard to lane against past level 3. If you get a lot of ganks it can be okay but 1v1 it's not playable. | In midlane it's playable, but challenging. Play for your jungler! Irelia is easy to gank for Zilean.

| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | In toplane it's impossible! You need jungle ganks or it's a go next! | Still very difficult in midlane, but atleast a bit more playable. His windwall and general mobility is not playable in a 1v1 situation. With ganks it can be okay.

| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Quite easy to lane against pre 6. Impossible to lane against post 6. She oneshots you in a single combo and is borderline impossible to kill or gank. | Try to make plays before level 6.
| FOR TOPLANE | Ban this champion. Urgot stands in front of the minions level 1 and you can never get a minion. Not winnable even with jungle support, he will just 2v1 you both.

| FOR TOPLANE | Ban or dodge this. Completely unplayable matchup. Even with jungle support you can never do anything to him. | However! You do scale well into him as your E is very good against him lategame. But goodluck getting to lategame.

| FOR TOPLANE | Jayce is fine in midlane, not playable against in toplane. | My personal ban right now as you really have nothing to say to him. He will destroy you with no issue. Maybe buy a cloth armour and 4 pots? Not sure if this one is winnable!
| FOR TOPLANE | Wukong clicks on you and you die. It's really that simple. Not playable lane unless he is a big monkey.
| FOR TOPLANE | Very difficult, but still playable. He does lack the damage to straight kill you and is heavily reliant on skillshots (which our E can dodge). Hard, but playable.

| FOR TOPLANE | Pantheon is terrible against Zilean mid, but in toplane the longer lane makes it very difficult to play. If you survive to level 6 you out scale him completely but getting there is a challenge!

| FOR TOPLANE | Pretty difficult but given some smart play and good spacing, actually winnable! If you get behind or make even 1 tiny misplay you just die instantly. Also she out scales you completely.

| FOR TOPLANE | Renekton mid is bad against Zilean. But in the longer lane of toplane it's quite difficult. If you play around Renekton E you can play the lane. If you misstep and he lands W you will get oneshot.
| FOR TOPLANE | Similar to Lucian but just a worse champion. Long range, damaging and has mobility. Only reason it's 'Major' and not 'Extreme' is due to the fact Quinn just gets ganked and dies.

| FOR MIDLANE | Viktor is one of those traditional counterpicks. He just out lanes Zilean. Nothing more, nothing less. He doesn't do anything specifically dangerous to Zilean it's just not a winnable lane. He will be up CS and Priority almost all the time.

| FOR MIDLANE | Laning is no problem. It's the roaming which is so very hard for Zilean. Zilean NEEDS a team to be able to play the game. Being able to take soloplates/farm while TF is gone does nothing for ZIlean, that is why this matchup is bad.

| FOR MIDLANE | Can be easy, can be hard. Really dependant on where the jungler is playing and how good the Zoe is. I think this matchup is quite hard for Zoe to play but if she is good Zilean is gonna get bullied hardcore. Getting oneshot in a bubble without being able to R is very tilting.

| FOR MIDLANE | Ekko can shove the wave level 1 before you have killed a single minion. Similar to Viktor in the way you just cannot win lane against this guy. Not unplayable, just super annoying and you start on the backfoot.
| FOR MIDLANE | Maybe I am just bad but I find Ryze lanes so very difficult. Due to phase rush it's challenging to land bombs on him. He spam shoves the wave and out scales you like crazy.

| FOR MIDLANE | If you make 1 misplay you can just go afk. However! If you play this lane respectful and smart, you can go even with little issue. Skill matchup with a huge downside if you get behind.

| FOR MIDLANE | A classic Zilean counter. Would be extreme counter but Fizz is just such a bad champion in S11. Don't die and you are good. Try not to be in lane against him. Keep roaming around and you should be good.

| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Much easier in midlane, but in toplane this matchup can be depressing. Use your E to dodge his Q and you are good. You may need to ultimate on very high HP as he oneshots you in a R + QQ + W + Auto + Goredrinker

| FOR MIDLANE | Sylas with Zilean ult sounds scary on paper, but most of the time people have no idea how to use it and it can just end up being worse than him taking a different ult. | Laning vs Sylas is not very difficult. Use E to dodge his E. If you get behind it's really bad but if you are even it's quite simple.
| FOR MIDLANE | Skill matchup. Play better and win, play worse and lose.
| FOR MIDLANE | Skill matchup. Play better and win, play worse and lose.
| FOR MIDLANE | Katarina cannot really lane against Zilean. The problem is when she walks out of lane and gets three kills and now you cannot lane against her. 1v1 is easy, roaming is difficult.

| FOR MIDLANE | Talon is melee. Zilean is very good against low mobility melees in mid. Press E on him and he can never reach you. Similar to Katarina if he gets fed you cannot do anything, but other than that you are golden.
| FOR MIDLANE | Very difficult pre 6. You can just ignore him later and he does not really interact well against Zilean lategame. You mostly ignore each other.
| FOR MIDLANE | Skill matchup. Play better and you win, play worse and you lose.
| FOR TOPLANE | Difficult, but playable! Skill matchup for sure. Double bomb when he Qs on you and then you can auto him down the lane with range superiority.
| FOR TOPLANE | Don't get grasp Q'd. Other than that it's a farm fiesta.
| FOR TOPLANE | Weird matchup. You cannot really die... but you can never kill him. He will free farm and outscale you. Try to make plays around the map and win early.
| FOR TOPLANE | If you fall behind there is no gameplay for you. Rengar top is just bad so generally speaking you should be fine if you don't int.

| FOR TOPLANE | If Darius takes ghost he can just run you down. If not, he can never touch you. If he lands E on you he will fully kill you, then again after you ult. You NEED to stay out of his E range and you are fine.
| FOR TOPLANE | "Camille?? Even??" You exclaim. My personal favourite matchup! Very fun to play and very skill based. Dodge her E, play around her ultimate and W cooldowns and you are good to go.
| FOR TOPLANE | He hits towers, you need towers.

| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Limited CC champion with a fairly weak earlygame. Exactly what Zilean wants to go against. Loseable lane sure, but in general it's fine. | Midlane is a bit harder than toplane due to the short trades he can take easier.
| FOR TOPLANE AND MIDLANE | Weirdly difficult lane. Realistically he cannot actually interact with you well but if you get hit by a single E you kinda just die.
| FOR TOPLANE | Mid Malphite is awful against Zilean, he just gets ganked. Toplane Malphite is just not well suited to deal with Zilean.
| FOR TOPLANE | Does not really do anything to Zilean. Afk lane which Zilean is always happy with.
| FOR TOPLANE | Riven doesn't really have the ability to catch you without using all of her spells. If she uses all of her spells she cannot kill you. Don't get oneshot in CC and you are good to go.
| FOR TOPLANE | With jungle support, you can be ground into blue paste. However, in a 1v1 scenario it's unlikely either of you can die in this lane. Respect his E and you will be fine.
| FOR TOPLANE | Only way to die is an E flash Q - W. Other than that this champion does not interact well with ZIlean.
| FOR TOPLANE | Wait what champion is this, is he new?
| FOR TOPLANE | Like an easier Gnar. A lot easier than Gnar.
| FOR MIDLANE | Ahri has a bad laning phase, but Zilean does too. Don't be stupid and you are fine!
| FOR MIDLANE | Brrrr very cold
| FOR MIDLANE | Your E is a death sentence for her. If she doesn't take phase rush then it's really difficult for her to play around Zilean. Don't all in her and you win always.
| FOR MIDLANE | Midlane?
| FOR MIDLANE | Really, boring, matchup.
| FOR MIDLANE | Even, more, boring, matchup.
| FOR MIDLANE | So, unbelievably, boring.
| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Can actually be kind of challenging. She spam shoves the wave and support her jungler. Generally speaking you should outperform her as Zilean is a better laner.
| FOR MIDLANE | Spam shoves, high CC, high damage. But Galio is really clunky and weird. It's totally playable.
| FOR TOPLANE | Press E on him
| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Dies to ganks, gives you a free lane.
| FOR MIDLANE | Dies to ganks, gives you a free lane.
| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Dies to ganks, gives you a free lane. Your E outranged all of his abilities, just press E on him.
| FOR MIDLANE | Press E on him.
| FOR TOPLANE | Cho'gath does not really have a good answer to Zilean E. However his silence is insane vs Zilean... if he can get in range.
| FOR MIDLANE | You outrange all of her spells.
| FOR MIDLANE AND TOPLANE | Like Karma but easier. She cannot properly lane against you.
| FOR MIDLANE | Protect your tower! Lane is easy but if you roam your tower dies instantly.
| FOR MIDLANE | She kinda does... exactly what Zilean does. Be the better support midlaner!
| FOR MIDLANE | Neither of you do anything.
| FOR MIDLANE | Press E on her.
| FOR TOPLANE | Press E on him. You win the 1v1 sure, but your towers don't. "easy" to lane against, difficult to win against.
| FOR TOPLANE | Press E on him.
| FOR TOPLANE | Press E on him.
| FOR TOPLANE | Press E on him.
| FOR TOPLANE | Press E on him.
| FOR TOPLANE | Your autos out range his turrets. He has no good answer to your E and gets ganked really easily. Don't get oneshot by his E - R and you good.
| FOR TOPLANE | The bully becomes the bullied. Zilean DESTROYS Teemo.
